messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jillian Park <jillian@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway surgery: micro-commit triage and stage hygiene sprint

Team —

Quick snapshot from finance: our weighted pipe-to-quota sits at ~0.78x for Q4 (coverage: $4.2M vs. target $5.4M). That leaves a gap of roughly $1.2M if current probabilities hold. We need a focused, 48-hour micro-commit sweep to:

- Lock down any near-term commits that can be pulled forward (EOW close)
- Clean stage hygiene (remove stale opps, confirm next milestones)
- Assign single-owner micro-actions per deal (exec intro, legal nudge, pricing concession)

I've attached a starter workbook (Q4_microcommit_matrix.xlsx) with the current top-20 deals and our suggested micro-actions. Please do the following by EOD today:

1) Own one or two deals from the sheet and update the "micro-action" + expected close date.
2) Note any blocker that needs leadership escalation.
3) If an account is no longer realistic, mark it STALE and reason.

We should run a 30-min sync at 1:30pm PT to finalize owners and escalate anything >$150k.

Rishi
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q4_microcommit_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway surgery: micro-commit triage and stage hygiene sprint

Thanks Rishi — good, crisp ask. I grabbed the sheet and started assigning owners for a first pass. A couple clarifications so we're aligned on definitions:

- "Commit" = legal/finance terms agreed + PO/intent received (probability 90%+)
- "Near-commit" = verbal ok + pricing agreed, waiting on final sign (probability 60–80%)
- "Hygiene: STALE" = no activity >60 days or prospect asked to pause

My plan:
- Ben: owns the two $200k+ opportunities (rows 1 & 3) — focus: exec intro + legal nudge.
- Laura: owns the mid-market cluster (rows 4–7) — focus: finalize SOW and confirm billing cadence.
- I will run the hubspot sweep and lock the "last touch" date on anything marked near-commit.

I added a short column in the sheet called "micro-owner" and put initial owners. Please update your rows directly. If anyone can't take an assignment, flag me and I'll reassign.

Proposed 30-min sync: 2028-08-15 13:30 PT (calendar invite sent). If you can't make it, add notes in the sheet before 13:00.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Midmarket Sales
Redwood Inference
